troops.name: Normal troop
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1/2 without spice, or 1 with 1 spice support.

rules.startText: 10 forces in Arrakeen and 10 in reserves. Start with 10 spice and 1 Treachery Card.

advantages.title: Bidding
advantages.text: Before bidding begins on each Treachery Card, you may inspect it. You alone may keep written records about Treachery Cards. You may share what you learn.
advantages.karama: Prevent inspection of one card.

advantages.title: Next spice
advantages.text: At the start of Shipment and Movement, before anyone moves, you may inspect the single top card of the Spice Deck, even with Double Spice Blow.
advantages.karama: Prevent this inspection.

advantages.title: Battle prescience
advantages.text: In each battle you may require your opponent to reveal the leader, weapon, defense or number dialed. An answer of no weapon or no defense uses the question. Voice precedes Prescience. You may not ask for the dial against a Richese No-Field.
advantages.karama: Prevent one battle question.

advantages.title: Advanced: Kwisatz Haderach
advantages.text: After losing at least 7 force tokens in battles, immediately activate the Kwisatz Haderach. In one territory per turn, it may accompany your leader or Cheap Hero for +2 strength. If that leader is killed, the bonus is lost. An accompanied leader cannot turn traitor. Only a lasgun-shield explosion kills the token. Revive it for 2 spice under leader revival rules; its status never delays revival of your five leaders.
advantages.karama: Prevent use in one battle before plans are revealed, not activation.

fate.title: Complete prescience:
fate.text: Advanced Game, once per game during Battle: spend a Karama before plans are revealed to inspect any one player's entire Battle Plan.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may require your ally's opponent to reveal one chosen battle-plan element to your ally.

troops.name: Harkonnen Troop
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1/2 without spice, or 1 with 1 spice support.

rules.startText: 10 forces in Carthag and 10 in reserves. Start with 10 spice and 2 Treachery Cards.

advantages.title: Traitors
advantages.text: Keep all 4 Traitor Cards dealt at setup, including your own. You may reveal a matching opponent leader in your own battle.
advantages.karama: Cannot stop a traitor call in your own battle.

advantages.title: Treachery
advantages.text: Your hand limit is 8. Whenever you buy a Treachery Card, draw one extra from the deck if room remains. With 7 cards, buying fills your hand and gives no bonus card. With 8, you must pass.
advantages.karama: Prevent one bonus card, not your hand limit.

advantages.title: Advanced: captured leaders
advantages.text: After a win you may randomly capture one available leader from the loser, including the battle leader if alive. Exclude dead leaders and those used elsewhere that turn. Inspect it, then kill it face down for 2 spice or keep it for one battle. A face-down execution counts as dying twice.
advantages.karama: Prevent capture after one battle.

advantages.title: Advanced: using a captive
advantages.text: A captive may turn traitor. Return it to its faction after its one battle if it survives. A killed captive goes to the Tanks for its own faction. Return all captives immediately when all your own leaders are dead. You and the original owner know its identity and may disclose it.
advantages.karama: Cannot stop use of an already captured leader.

fate.title: Exchange secrets:
fate.text: Advanced Game, once per game during Bidding: spend a Karama to take up to 4 random cards from another hand. Combine them with your hand, then give that player the same number of cards of your choice. You may return cards just taken. A full hand does not prevent this temporary exchange.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may reveal a traitor matching the opposing leader in your ally's battle. Karama may prevent this allied traitor call.

troops.name: Normal troop
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1/2 without spice, or 1 with 1 spice support.

troops.name: Sardaukar
troops.description: Basic: ordinary force. Advanced: strength 1 without spice, or 2 with 1 spice; ordinary against Fremen.

rules.startText: 20 forces in reserves. Start with 10 spice and 1 Treachery Card.
rules.revivalText: 1 force free; normal total limit 3. Advanced: at most 1 Sardaukar per turn.

advantages.title: Bidding income
advantages.text: Other factions pay their normal Treachery auction purchases to you. You may not discount their price. Pay the Spice Bank for your own purchases.
advantages.karama: Redirect one purchase payment to the Bank.

advantages.title: Advanced: Sardaukar
advantages.text: Your 5 starred forces are Sardaukar. Each has strength 2 when supported with 1 spice, or strength 1 without support. Against Fremen each counts as an ordinary force, strength 1 with spice or 1/2 without it. Only 1 Sardaukar may be revived each turn, including Ghola and allied effects. In the Basic Game starred forces are ordinary.
advantages.karama: Treat Sardaukar as ordinary forces for one battle; play before reveal.

fate.title: Imperial revival:
fate.text: Advanced Game, once per game during Revival: spend a Karama to revive up to 3 forces or 1 leader free. These are additional to normal revival, but do not bypass the one-Sardaukar-per-turn limit.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may give your ally spice directly at any time for any reason; it is immediately usable. During Revival you may pay for up to 3 extra of its forces, beyond its normal limit, at 2 spice each. Pay the Bank, or Tleilaxu if its revival-income advantage applies. Karama may prevent one affected spice gift or the extra revivals.

troops.name: Troop
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1/2 without spice, or 1 with 1 spice support.

rules.startText: 5 forces in Tuek's Sietch and 15 in reserves. Start with 5 spice and 1 Treachery Card.

advantages.title: Shipment income
advantages.text: Other factions pay you for shipments from their reserves onto Arrakis. Pay the Spice Bank for your own shipments.
advantages.karama: Redirect one shipment payment to the Bank.

advantages.title: Three shipment types
advantages.text: For your one shipment, either ship reserves to one Arrakis territory, cross-ship a group between two Arrakis territories, or return a group from a territory to reserves. Apply storm and occupancy rules.
advantages.karama: Prevent one cross-shipment or return to reserves.

advantages.title: Guild rates
advantages.text: For shipment to Arrakis or cross-shipment, pay half normal cost, rounding the total up. Returning forces to reserves costs 1 spice per 2 forces, rounded up; do not halve that rate again.
advantages.karama: Remove your half-price rate for one shipment.

advantages.title: Special victory
advantages.text: If the game ends without a normal winner and the Fremen Special Victory Condition is not met, you and your ally win. Bene Gesserit cannot predict this special victory.
advantages.karama: Cannot prevent the special victory.

advantages.title: Advanced: choose your moment
advantages.text: Take your whole shipment-and-movement turn first, last or between other factions. Announce when taking it. Other players keep normal order. Do not interrupt another player's turn.
advantages.karama: Take shipment and movement in normal storm order this turn; do not retry the out-of-order advantage later.

fate.title: Deny passage:
fate.text: Advanced Game, once per game during Shipment and Movement: spend a Karama to stop one other player's off-planet shipment.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: Your ally may ship reserves to Arrakis or cross-ship at your half-price rates, paying you. It cannot ship forces back to reserves. Allied Fremen may use the reserve cross-shipment allowed by the November 2020 FAQ. Your ally shares your special victory.

troops.name: Normal troop
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1 without spice.

troops.name: Fedaykin
troops.description: Basic: ordinary force. Advanced: strength 2 without spice.

rules.startText: Divide 10 forces between Sietch Tabr, False Wall South and False Wall West; 10 in reserves. Start with 3 spice and 1 Treachery Card.
rules.revivalText: 3 forces free; no extra paid base-game revivals. Advanced: at most 1 Fedaykin per turn.

advantages.title: Reserve placement
advantages.text: For shipment, place any number of reserves free in The Great Flat or one territory within 2 territory borders of it. Do not count The Great Flat itself. Apply storm and occupancy rules. This is not an ordinary paid off-planet shipment.
advantages.karama: Cannot prevent normal reserve placement.

advantages.title: Movement
advantages.text: Your normal movement range is 2 territories, or 3 with ornithopters.
advantages.karama: Limit one movement to 1 territory without ornithopters.

advantages.title: Shai-Hulud
advantages.text: Worms do not devour your forces. After the Nexus you may ride a worm with some or all forces at its location to any one territory, including a stronghold, subject to storm and occupancy. This does not use normal movement.
advantages.karama: Cancel protection and riding against one worm.

advantages.title: Special victory
advantages.text: If no normal victory occurred by the end of turn 10, win with your ally if only you or nobody occupies Sietch Tabr and Habbanya Sietch, and neither Atreides, Harkonnen nor Emperor occupies Tuek's Sietch. Richese also prevents the Tuek's condition when in play. Ecaz has its printed Occupy exception.
advantages.karama: Cannot prevent the special victory.

advantages.title: Advanced: storm cards
advantages.text: After the first dialed storm, secretly select a Storm Card for the next turn. Reveal it next Storm Phase, move that distance, return and shuffle it, then select the following card.
advantages.karama: Prevent viewing the next card, not movement by its revealed distance.

advantages.title: Advanced: desert survival
advantages.text: Lose half the force tokens caught by storm, rounding losses up. You may place reserves into storm at half loss, but cannot move or worm ride into or out of storm. Additional consecutive worms after the first may be placed in sand territories of your choice.
advantages.karama: Cancel one relevant storm or additional-worm advantage.

advantages.title: Advanced: Fedaykin and support
advantages.text: Your 3 Fedaykin count as strength 2 in battle and losses. All your forces fight at full strength without spice. At most 1 Fedaykin may be revived per turn. Starred forces are ordinary in the Basic Game.
advantages.karama: Cancel doubled Fedaykin strength or no-spice support separately, before reveal.

fate.title: Call a worm:
fate.text: Advanced Game, once per game during Spice Blow and Nexus: spend a Karama to place a worm in a chosen sand territory. Destroy its spice and unprotected other forces, allow your forces to ride, and cause a Nexus at phase end.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may protect your ally from a worm and allow it 3 free revivals, subject to its applicable revival limit. It does not gain worm riding. Your ally shares your special victory.

troops.name: Fighter
troops.description: Basic: strength 1. Advanced: strength 1/2 without spice, or 1 with 1 spice support.

back.name: Advisor
back.description: Advanced advisor: cannot fight, collect spice, provide ornithopters or count toward control.

rules.startText: Basic: 1 force in Polar Sink, 19 in reserves. Advanced: 1 advisor anywhere after Fremen placement, 19 in reserves. Start with 5 spice and 1 card.

advantages.title: Prediction
advantages.text: After positions are chosen, secretly predict one other faction and turn. If it wins normally on that turn, alone or in an alliance, reveal your prediction and win alone instead. You may also win normally. You cannot predict Fremen or Guild special victories.
advantages.karama: Cannot stop prediction.

advantages.title: Spiritual advisors
advantages.text: When another faction ships from off-planet to Arrakis, you may ship 1 reserve force free to Polar Sink. Advanced: instead accompany that shipment to its destination as an advisor. Fremen reserve placement and Guild cross-shipment do not trigger this.
advantages.karama: Prevent one accompanying shipment.

advantages.title: Voice
advantages.text: Before Prescience, require your opponent to play or not play one weapon, defense, Worthless Card or Cheap Hero in its plan. You may name a legal category or a specific special card. If compliance is impossible it may make any otherwise legal plan.
advantages.karama: Prevent one Voice.

advantages.title: Advanced: charity and Karama
advantages.text: Receive 2 spice in every Charity Phase regardless of holdings, including turn 1. You may use any Worthless Card as a Karama.
advantages.karama: Prevent charity beyond normal eligibility, or prevent one Worthless Card being used as Karama; that card is discarded.

advantages.title: Advanced: advisors
advantages.text: Advisors cannot fight, collect spice, count for control or stronghold limits, give ornithopters, or enable Family Atomics. They remain vulnerable to worm, storm, lasgun-shield explosion and atomics. All your forces in a territory must be the same type. Advisors alone automatically become fighters.
advantages.karama: Prevent one relevant flip.

advantages.title: Advanced: flipping
advantages.text: After Spice Blow and Nexus but before any shipment, announce and flip advisors to fighters where you wish to battle, except under storm or with an ally. When another faction enters your fighters' territory, you may flip them to advisors immediately. Advisors moving into another occupied territory may stay advisors or flip. Forces joining your existing forces take their type.

advantages.title: Advanced: accompanying
advantages.text: An advisor accompanying another shipment cannot flip to fighter that turn unless alone. When alone at setup it flips immediately. Normal alliance separation applies to advisors; Homeworlds cannot receive them.

fate.title: No separate special power:
fate.text: You have no once-per-game Special Karama Power. In the Advanced Game, your ordinary faction advantage lets you use Worthless Cards as Karama Cards.
fate.label: karama

alliance.text: You may Voice your ally's opponent before any Atreides battle question.
